sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def knob(fr):
    L = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(17,25) for c in range(10,46) if L[r][c] in 'bS']
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
def wcount(fr):
    L = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for r in range(44,63) for c in range(10,38) if L[r][c]=='W')

print('before:', knob(current_frame), 'W:', wcount(current_frame))
res = action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT'])
print('after batch, result:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','board_changed')})
for i,t in enumerate(transitions[-4:]):
    print('LEFT', i, 'knob:', knob(t.after_frame), 'W:', wcount(t.after_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def knob(fr):
    L = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    cells = [(r,c) for r in range(17,25) for c in range(10,46) if L[r][c] in 'bS']
    if not cells: return None
    rs=[r for r,c in cells]; cs=[c for r,c in cells]
    return (min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs))
def wcount(fr):
    L = fr.ascii.split('\n')
    return sum(1 for r in range(44,63) for c in range(10,38) if L[r][c]=='W')

print('before:', knob(current_frame), 'W:', wcount(current_frame))
res = action(['LEFT','LEFT','LEFT','LEFT'])
print('after batch, result:', {k:last_action_result.get(k) for k in ('done','level_completed','game_over','run_complete','board_changed')})
for i,t in enumerate(transitions[-4:]):
    print('LEFT', i, 'knob:', knob(t.after_frame), 'W:', wcount(t.after_frame))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
